title: Workflow State
description: Schema for .orca/workflow-state.json — the persistent state file for multi-agent-workflow runs. v2.2.0: one run = one feature = ONE shared feature worktree + ONE feature branch (feature/<slug>, based on origin/main) + ONE PR. The coordinator stays on the main branch and never checks out; subtasks execute inside the shared worktree and are kept parallel-safe by disjoint per-subtask `owns` path globs, not by filesystem isolation. Per-subtask worktrees/branches/PRs, stacked branches, and draft PRs are removed.

workflow_id.description: Unique identifier for this workflow run

version.description: Skill version used for this run

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of workflow completion (omitted if still running)

current_state.description: Current state (may differ from phase during transitions)

delivery_mode.description: Whether all artifacts were delivered (full) or some failed (degraded)

feature_slug.description: Slug identifying the single feature for this run; names the worktree and the feature/<slug> branch

worktree.description: The ONE shared feature worktree (Phase 4), created via `orca worktree create --name <feature_slug> --base-branch origin/main`. All subtasks execute here.

id.description: Orca worktree id, read from the create command's JSON result

path.description: Absolute path to the feature worktree

pr.description: The ONE PR for the whole feature, created in Phase 7 (MERGING) after integration review passes

integration_review.description: Whole-feature review in Phase 7 (new in v2.2.0): a fresh review-agent terminal reviews the plan, per-subtask verdicts, test results, and `git diff origin/main...HEAD`; ≤ max_integration_review_rounds (default 2) fix/re-review rounds, then human decision (release anyway or PARK)

rounds.description: Integration review rounds executed so far

subtasks.description: One entry per sub-task in the DAG. v2.2.0: all sub-tasks share the single feature worktree (see top-level `worktree`); parallel safety within a wave comes from disjoint `owns` globs, validated during plan review.

owns.description: File/dir path globs this sub-task owns; same-wave (parallel) sub-tasks must have disjoint owns

base_sha.description: Feature-branch HEAD recorded at each dispatch; the review agent reviews only <base_sha>..HEAD changes within this sub-task's owns

initial_base_sha.description: Feature-branch HEAD recorded once at the round-0 dispatch. Start of the degrade-revert range (§10): a failed sub-task's commits are reverted via <initial_base_sha>..HEAD limited to its owns

review_rounds.description: Number of cross-review rounds executed in Phase 5

terminals.description: Every terminal spawned for this sub-task, oldest first — a fresh terminal per round in the shared feature worktree. Intermediate terminals are closed after each round; the keep_terminal stays alive until Phase 8.

agent_type.description: Resolved Agent name (claude / kimi / grok / pi)

keep_terminal.description: Handle of the terminal that produced the final implementation; torn down in Phase 8.

subtask_id.description: Scope of the decision — null = workflow-level, otherwise the sub-task it applies to
Scope of the error — null/omitted = workflow-level, otherwise the sub-task it applies to
